intro: Our urban master planning work turns land into communities. West Links is a residential community next to a Scottish golf club. Evergreens is a master-planned gated community of luxury villas in Hyderabad, India. Orel turns unused land in Russia into an eco-farm. In Dubai, Skye Residences brings city living to Downtown.

seo.title: Urban Master Planning Projects | Nellis Architecture
seo.description: Urban master planning and master plan architecture by Nellis Architecture: residential and gated villa communities and an eco-farm in Scotland, India, Russia.
